intro.heading: Architectural design services
intro.subheading: Thoughtful, buildable designs for Sri Lankan sites, climates and budgets — from a single room to a full commercial building.

services.title: House Plans
services.shortDescription: Custom home designs that make the most of your land, light and budget.
services.longDescription:
We start with your plot, your family and your budget. After a site visit and a brief, we develop concept sketches, then refine them into detailed floor plans, elevations and sections.

Our designs respond to Sri Lankan conditions — cross-ventilation, deep eaves for monsoon rains and orientation that keeps rooms cool without relying on air-conditioning.

image.alt: Floor plan of a three-bedroom house

services.title: Building Approval Drawings
services.shortDescription: Complete drawing sets for local authority and UDA approval.
services.longDescription:
Getting a building permit can be slow and confusing. We prepare complete submission sets — site plans, architectural drawings and structural details — in the format required by Municipal Councils, Pradeshiya Sabhas and the UDA.

We also follow up on comments and resubmissions until your approval is granted.

services.title: 3D Renders & Walkthroughs
services.shortDescription: See your building before it's built with photorealistic renders and videos.
services.longDescription:
Photorealistic exterior and interior renders help you make decisions with confidence — and help banks, investors and family understand the design.

For larger projects we produce animated walkthroughs that you can share on any phone.

services.title: Interior Design
services.shortDescription: Functional, beautiful interiors with furniture, lighting and finish schedules.
services.longDescription:
We design interiors that suit how you live and work — layouts, built-in joinery, lighting, colour and finishes — and provide drawings your carpenter and contractor can build from.

We can source locally made furniture and materials to keep costs reasonable.

services.title: Landscape Design
services.shortDescription: Gardens, driveways and outdoor spaces designed for the tropics.
services.longDescription: A well-planned garden keeps a house cool, manages rainwater and adds value. We design landscapes with native and low-maintenance plants, proper drainage, paving and outdoor living spaces.

services.title: Renovation Designs
services.shortDescription: Extend, convert or modernise an existing building safely.
services.longDescription: Adding a floor, opening up walls or converting a house into an office needs careful design. We survey the existing building, check the structure, and design changes that are safe, approvable and respectful of the original.

intro.heading: Engineering that stands the test of time
intro.subheading: Structural, mechanical and MEP design, supervision and cost planning by chartered engineers.

services.title: Structural Design
services.shortDescription: Safe, economical structures for houses, multi-storey and commercial buildings.
services.longDescription:
We design reinforced concrete, steel and composite structures — foundations, columns, beams, slabs and roofs — balancing safety with material cost.

All designs follow Eurocode and relevant Sri Lankan standards, with full calculations and detailed reinforcement drawings.

services.title: Mechanical Services
services.shortDescription: Ventilation, air-conditioning and plumbing systems that run efficiently.
services.longDescription: We design HVAC, ventilation, water supply and drainage systems sized correctly for the building — reducing running costs and avoiding over-specified equipment.

services.title: MEP Design
services.shortDescription: Coordinated mechanical, electrical and plumbing design for complete buildings.
services.longDescription: Our MEP team coordinates electrical, lighting, fire protection, plumbing and mechanical systems with the architecture and structure so that services fit — avoiding clashes and costly site changes.

services.title: Site Supervision
services.shortDescription: Regular inspections so construction matches the approved drawings.
services.longDescription:
We inspect critical stages — foundations, reinforcement before concreting, and structural members — and issue reports with clear instructions to the contractor.

It protects your investment and is often required for the Certificate of Conformity (COC).

services.title: Quantity Surveying & BOQ
services.shortDescription: Accurate Bills of Quantities and cost estimates in LKR.
services.longDescription: A detailed BOQ lets you compare contractor quotes fairly, plan bank loans and track spending. We prepare BOQs, cost estimates, tender documents and interim payment valuations.

services.title: Structural Assessment
services.shortDescription: Condition surveys and strength checks for existing buildings.
services.longDescription: Cracks, leaks or plans to add a floor? We assess existing structures with visual surveys and non-destructive tests, then report on safety and recommend repairs or strengthening.

image.alt: Engineer examining a crack in a wall

intro.heading: Completed projects
intro.subheading: Homes, offices, hotels and public buildings we've designed and engineered across Sri Lanka.

items.title: Hillside Residence
items.summary: A three-storey family home stepped into a steep hillside overlooking the Mahaweli valley.
items.description:
The 15-perch sloping plot called for a split-level design with a retaining-wall foundation. Living spaces open onto cantilevered terraces facing the view, while bedrooms sit on the cooler, uphill side.

Medura handled architecture, structural design, Kandy Municipal Council approval and site supervision through to the COC.

items.title: Union Place Office Building
items.summary: An eight-storey office building with basement parking on a tight city-centre plot.
items.description:
We delivered the structural and MEP design for this 4,200 m² office building, including a two-level basement with secant-pile retaining walls.

Variable-refrigerant-flow air-conditioning and LED lighting with daylight sensors cut projected energy use by around 30%.

items.title: Boutique Villa
items.summary: A six-room boutique villa with a courtyard pool, a short walk from the beach.
items.description:
Inspired by southern coastal architecture, the villa wraps around a central courtyard and pool, with deep verandas and clay-tile roofs.

We designed for salt-air durability with higher concrete cover and corrosion-resistant fittings throughout.

items.title: Science Laboratory Block
items.summary: A two-storey laboratory block for a national school, with four labs and a lecture hall.
items.description: Designed for natural ventilation and daylight, the building uses a steel-framed roof with clerestory windows. We prepared the BOQ and tender documents and supervised construction to handover.

items.title: Lagoon View Apartments
items.summary: Twelve apartments over five floors with lagoon views and rooftop gardens.
items.description: A compact apartment block with a raft foundation suited to the sandy coastal soil. Units are arranged so every apartment gets cross-ventilation and a balcony facing the lagoon.

items.title: Tea Estate Bungalow Restoration
items.summary: Restoring and extending a 1920s planters' bungalow while keeping its colonial character.
items.description:
After a structural assessment of the timber roof and rubble walls, we strengthened the original structure and added a new guest wing in a sympathetic style.

Modern plumbing, electrical and heating were integrated discreetly.

items.title: Vehicle Showroom & Service Centre
items.summary: A column-free 30 m span showroom with an attached service workshop.
items.description: A long-span steel portal frame gives an open, column-free showroom floor. The workshop includes oil interceptors, compressed-air lines and heavy-duty industrial flooring.

items.title: Courtyard Family Home
items.summary: A single-storey home built around a traditional central courtyard (mutram).
items.description: The design reinterprets the northern courtyard house: rooms open onto a shaded mutram that draws breezes through the home. Thick walls and a reflective roof keep interiors cool in the dry-zone heat.

intro.heading: A small team with big attention to detail
intro.subheading: Architects and engineers working side by side, so your project is designed, approved and built right the first time.

story.heading: Our story
paragraphs: Medura was founded in Kandy in 2013 by a civil engineer and an architect who were tired of seeing good designs fail on site because nobody connected the drawings to the construction.

Today we are a team of architects, chartered engineers, quantity surveyors and draughtspeople serving clients across 18 districts — from first-time home builders to schools, hotels and commercial developers.
Our promise is simple: clear advice, honest budgets and drawings that work in the real world.
